question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who does not believe in God
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Atheist"** means a person who does not believe in the existence of God. (नास्तिक)

 
 
• **Example:** John declared himself an atheist, stating that he doesn't believe in any deities.
 
 
 
• **"Amateur"** refers to a person who engages in a pursuit, especially a sport, on an unpaid basis. (शौक़ीन)
 
 
• **Example:** She is an amateur painter who enjoys creating art in her free time.
 
 
 
• **"Anarchy"** means a state of disorder due to the absence or non-recognition of authority or other controlling systems. (अराजकता)
 
 
• **Example:** The country fell into anarchy after the government collapsed.
 
 
 
• **"Autocrat"** refers to a ruler who has absolute power. (तानाशाह)
 
 
• **Example:** The autocrat imposed strict rules and regulations on the people.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**
